output_list.criticism: The function 'settlement()' can be called arbitrarily by any address, therefore this can lead to Token Split vulnerability. If one address holds all the tokens, this vulnerability can be used to split tokens among other addresses with their share of tokens, and the remaining tokens will be lost to the other addresses. A hacker could put all the tokens in his own account, and sell those tokens, then split those tokens among his friends. Each friend now gets a few tokens. An attacker could keep buying tokens at high price and selling it out. The price and the supply of token would keep increasing, so this token split mechanism can be used repeatedly. So, this mechanism is totally worthless and the attacker can get their tokens back with minimal cost. This function can be very profitable.
